name: Test Designer
description: Agent that reads a contract definition and generates executable test configurations. Purely generative — reads contract, writes test suite, validates output.

contract-reading.description: Read and understand a contract definition

tests.description: Lists all features from a given contract
tests.prompt: Analyze this contract and list all features that need testing: {"id":"example","features":{"greeting":{"description":"Say hello","requires":["conversation"],"tests":[{"id":"hello","prompt":"Hi","check":{"type":"non-empty"}}]},"math":{"description":"Do math","requires":["reasoning"],"tests":[{"id":"add","prompt":"2+2?","check":{"type":"contains","value":"4"}}]}}}
What capabilities are needed for the 'math' feature in this contract? {"features":{"math":{"requires":["reasoning","structured-output"]}}}
A contract has minimumFitness: 0.75. A block scores 0.72 on the weighted average. Does it pass the contract?

test-generation.description: Generate valid test configurations from contract specs

tests.description: Generates a valid single-turn test config
tests.prompt: Generate a BlockTestRun JSON config for this contract test: {"id":"basic-response","prompt":"Hello","check":{"type":"non-empty","minLength":20}}

tests.description: Generates a valid multi-turn test config
tests.prompt: Generate a BlockTestRun JSON config for this multi-turn test: {"id":"context-retention","turns":[{"prompt":"My name is Bob"},{"prompt":"What is my name?","check":{"type":"contains","value":"Bob"}}]}

tests.description: Generates a test that verifies tool call behavior
tests.prompt: Generate a test config that verifies the agent calls 'session-create' with argument 'name' when asked to create a session

tests.description: Generated tests use multiple check types, not just non-empty
tests.prompt: Generate 4 tests for a code-reviewer feature called 'review-quality'. The agent should provide actionable code review feedback. Use at least 3 different check types.

output-format.description: Produced test suite follows the correct JSON schema

tests.description: Test suite JSON contains all required top-level fields
tests.prompt: Generate a test suite for a contract with id 'greeting' that has one feature 'say-hello' with one test. Write the complete test suite JSON to /output/greeting.test-suite.json.

tests.description: The written test suite file is valid JSON
tests.prompt: Generate a minimal test suite for a contract called 'simple'. It has one feature 'basic' with one test: prompt 'Hello', check non-empty. Write to /output/simple.test-suite.json.

completeness.description: Generated tests cover all features in the source contract

tests.description: Test suite has tests for every feature in the contract
tests.prompt: Read this contract and generate tests for ALL features: {"id":"multi-feature","features":{"auth":{"description":"Authentication","requires":["tool-calling"],"weight":0.4,"tests":[]},"logging":{"description":"Activity logging","requires":["structured-output"],"weight":0.3,"tests":[]},"retry":{"description":"Retry on failure","requires":["conversation"],"weight":0.3,"tests":[]}}}. Write the test suite to /output/multi-feature.test-suite.json.

turns.prompt: What are the feature IDs in that contract?

scoring.description: Score = sum(feature.weight * feature.score). Test designer must reliably produce executable, complete test suites.
